maximum_page_geometry: four 768x1024 static/goal pages plus two 128x128 unlabelled scenes; fixed per task and invariant to current state
observation_guard: SceneOnlyViews.observe counts the complete projected messages with image geometry and rejects over-limit requests without truncation; VisualPolicy repeats the batch/context checks before generation.
limit_semantics: Every admitted input fits the qualified envelope; oversized runtime requests remain explicit failures, not truncated/hidden inputs. Reference maxima alone are not claimed to bound off-policy requests.
adapter_bank: all four retained v5 algorithm adapters per modality
reference_envelope_projection: maximum measured complete reference-input length per modality plus 32 synthetic probe tokens; force full output; worst of base/SFT and both GPU timings; batch-normalize by two
cost_scope: aggregate worker GPU seconds, including readiness, qualification and model/adapter loading; baseline shares 56 GPU-hours
bound_vs_estimate: Full-capacity timing also reported. Reference-envelope projection is a cost proxy, not an assertion that all off-policy calls have reference lengths; scheduler caps still govern incomplete outcomes.
